definitions.gloss: prevention of recurrence; measures to prevent reoccurrence
definitions.explanation: Steps taken to ensure that a problem, accident, mistake, or illness does not happen again. A key concept in Japanese business culture and quality management.

examples.japanese: {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: To think of measures to prevent recurrence.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じミスが{起|お}きないよう{再発防止|さいはつぼうし}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: We are working on preventing the same mistake from happening again.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}を{徹底的|てっていてき}に{調査|ちょうさ}し、{再発防止|さいはつぼうし}に{努|つと}めると{会社|かいしゃ}は{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The company announced that it would thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident and work to prevent recurrence.

notes:
Composed of {再発|さいはつ} (recurrence) + {防止|ぼうし} (prevention). A very common term in business, healthcare, and government. In Japanese corporate culture, documenting {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく} (preventive measures) after an incident is a standard practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{策|さく}: preventive measures
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}に{努|つと}める: to strive to prevent recurrence
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}に{取|と}り{組|く}む: to work on preventing recurrence
- {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}{報告書|ほうこくしょ}: incident prevention report

USAGE:
Often seen in formal apologies and press conferences when companies or organizations address problems. The phrase {再発防止|さいはつぼうし}に{努|つと}めます ("We will strive to prevent recurrence") is a standard expression.

RELATED WORDS:
- {再発|さいはつ}: recurrence — of a disease, problem, or incident
- {防止|ぼうし}: prevention — used in many compounds
- {未然|みぜん}に{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent before it happens — a more general preventive concept
